name: MOLOTOW JASS
description: Molotow Jass is a Swiss Jass game for four players, derived from Mittlere Jass. It uses the same dynamic trump determination (first void play establishes trumps) but adapts the scoring for four players. The game features unique scoring where the middle two players can end up with potatoes while the highest and lowest scorers get sticks.

content.text: Molotow Jass is a Swiss Jass game for four players, derived from Mittlere Jass. It uses the same dynamic trump determination (first void play establishes trumps) but adapts the scoring for four players. The game features unique scoring where the middle two players can end up with potatoes while the highest and lowest scorers get sticks.
Molotow Jass was derived from Mittlere Jass (for three players) to accommodate four players. The game preserves the dynamic trump mechanism while adapting the middle-score concept to four players.
36-card Jass deck (6 through Ace in four suits: Acorns, Shields, Flowers, Bells). Can use standard deck with 5s and below removed.
36-card Jass deck or modified standard deck, scoring slate (for sticks and potatoes).
9 cards to each player, dealt in packets of 3. Deal and play are anticlockwise.

items.text: Mittlere Jass: The three-player parent game with different scoring.
Plus-Minus Jass: Related variant with different scoring structure.
